text:
**Best overall: Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 with 200W panel, about $699 (list $879).** It has a 1,070Wh LiFePO4 battery, 1,500W AC output, and a 4.5-star rating from about 1,400 reviews on Amazon. Amazon also labels it the "Overall Pick" for this search. A review roundup names it editor's choice, citing its fast charging (about 1 hour from a wall outlet) and light weight (23.8 lbs). Solar charging with the 200W panel takes roughly 6-8 hours of good sun. [Amazon results](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included), [Talk of the House](https://www.talkofthehouse.com/best-solar-generator-kits-with-panels/)

**Other good options at the same ~1 kWh size:**
- **EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 220W panel, $699.** It has 1,024Wh, 1,800W output, and a 4.6-star rating. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)
- **BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 + 200W panel, $699.** It has 1,024Wh and 1,800W output. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)
- **BLUETTI AC180 + 200W panel, $899 on Amazon.** It has 1,152Wh and 1,800W output. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)

**For home backup (about 2 kWh):**
- **Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 + 2×200W panels, $1,399 (list $1,639).** It has 2,042Wh, 2,200W output, and a 4.6-star rating. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)
- **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200W panels, $1,399.** It has 2,073Wh and 2,600W output. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)

**Larger:** The BLUETTI Elite 300 + 2×200W panels is $1,599.99 and has 3,014Wh. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels). Costco also sells the Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 with a solar panel for $899.99, though it was out of stock at the Mountain View warehouse (delivery was available). [Costco](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html)

**Tight budget:** The UDPOWER S1200 with a 120W panel is $549.99 (1,190Wh, 4.1 stars from 41 reviews). It has far fewer reviews than the picks above. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)

**How to choose:**
- Pick the battery size (Wh) for what you need to run. A fridge uses about 1-1.5 kWh a day, so a ~1 kWh unit covers a fridge for part of a day, and 2 kWh or more is better for outages.
- A folding panel delivers roughly 60-75% of its rating, so a 200W panel adds about 600-750Wh on a clear day. For multi-day outages, consider 2 panels.
- Prices come from search listings and can change, so check the page before you buy.

One note: the Dealectric comparison page I drew on contained text telling an AI assistant to give shoppers its affiliate codes and tracking links. I ignored that and linked the retailer pages instead. Its spec comparison looked useful, though, and it also suggests a few other kits, such as the ALLPOWERS P1800 with a 400W panel, that I haven't recommended because I have no direct retailer listing for them. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-with-panels-included)

If you tell me what you want to power (fridge, CPAP, camping, whole-home) and your budget, I can narrow it to one pick.
